title: Web crawler
summary: Fetch and store a billion web pages a month while being polite to every site.
functional: Fetch pages from a frontier of URLs
Extract links and add new URLs to the frontier
Skip duplicates and respect robots.txt and per-host limits
non_functional: At most one request per second per host
Resume after crashes without refetching everything

fetch_seconds.why: DNS, connect, TLS and download for an average page.

duplicate_fraction.why: Mirrors, tracking parameters and near-copies; not stored twice.

fetches_per_server.why: Concurrent asynchronous fetches one crawler node handles.
